contrast_floor_role: numerical normalized-RMSE floor only; no inherited semantic floor for eF-eP; historical M3 acceptance threshold is not an advantage floor
metric: Paper1 M3: RMS over equally weighted remaining future steps and all 2x4 primitives after physical denormalization and division by frozen truth-only scales; target native-CF decode as explicitly requested, not simulator truth
aggregation: checkpoint-first; time-band median within each unit then across units; normalized recovery only where individual A>numerical floor; show counts, raw errors and paired effects
inplane_algorithm: SHA256 UTF8 literal, first 8 digest bytes big-endian unsigned seed; NumPy PCG64 standard_normal(4); float64 Gram-Schmidt against full affine c; fallback basis least aligned with c if residual norm <=1e-12; normalize once; exactly one direction per unit
inplane_c: full affine primitive_features with frozen feature normalization @ affine_weights; actual P0-F0 equals U4c up to float32 addition rounding
inplane_anchor: (s @ U4.T)*norm(actual P0-F0), calculated float64 then cast float32
wrong_object: other object; same axis and signed delta; factual_values baseline equals other factual velocity; counterfactual baseline+delta; full affine mapper; unchanged factual state
scale_formula: target L2 norm / (transported sham L2 norm + 1e-24), float64 norm and scaling then float32 vector
extreme_scale_role: descriptive flag only; never exclusion or direction reselection
primary: raw paired native-CF future error sham minus correct on every numerically evaluable unit-time; no contrastability filter
wins: strict raw error correct < sham on all evaluable unit-times
checkpoints: allocated separately before training; no replacement
functional_raw_gate_population: Among contrastable unit-times, within-unit temporal median then stratum median of eT and eF; additionally report unfiltered raw medians
unit_positive_advantage_gate: within-unit median A > 0 on all registered times; at least 75% of all units
population_selection: Canonical candidate stream; first 8 simulator-valid accepted candidates per object/axis slot in each stratum; no model conditioning; no retuning sign/amplitude support

transport_capture.Q: float64 thin SVD of raw factual Phi U4; inherited rank mask s > smax * (192*2**-23); no rank adaptation
transport_capture.population: all numerically valid unit-times, nested temporal/unit medians
transport_capture.separation: later P used for evaluation only; never passed to T construction

paired_statistics.unit: unit-level all-time median of raw paired sham-minus-correct effect; no unit-time pseudoreplication
paired_statistics.wilcoxon: two-sided exact conditional signed-rank distribution by dynamic programming, average ranks for exact abs-value ties, discard exact zeros (wilcox); all zeros p=1; no rounding of effects
paired_statistics.holm_family: six tests within each checkpoint: S1 x three shams plus S2 x three shams; monotone step-down adjusted p < 0.05 in every comparison
paired_statistics.bootstrap: PCG64, 20000 unit-level with-replacement samples; median statistic; percentile 2.5/97.5 using linear quantile; descriptive only
paired_statistics.permutation: 65536 Rademacher sign-flips of unit-level effects, statistic absolute mean; two-sided plus-one Monte Carlo p; descriptive only
paired_statistics.seed_derivation: first 8 SHA256 UTF8 digest bytes unsigned big endian
paired_statistics.invalid: nonfinite unit data fail numerical gate; never silently drop invalid units

historical_continuity.reason: Optional diagnostics deferred to avoid extending RC preparation; never fresh gates.

coordinate_boundary: Native carrier coordinates only; no intrinsic 4-D state, coordinate-invariant transported manifold, minimal realization, predictive state, closed rank-4 subsystem, universal world-model mechanism, or tangent-method novelty.
